verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents built-in agent support across several model vendors (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok) plus open-source frameworks like BrowserUse, so it is not locked to one vendor. Nothing shows a developer can plug in an arbitrary LLM provider or their own keys, or configure which model HyperAgent uses. missing for 10: documented bring-your-own-provider/API-key configuration, HyperAgent LLM selection docs, support for arbitrary or local models, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bring my own LLM provider — the framework is model-agnostic rather than locked to one vendor's models

citations.quote: Built in support for Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok, and BrowserUse agents.
Whether you prefer open-source frameworks or cutting‑edge model-native agents, you can start tasks with a single API call
